name: Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker
tagline: The Modern Link Routing, Geolocation, and Automated Compliance Engine
description: Transform ugly referral links into branded short links while automating FTC legal disclosures, dynamic geo-targeting, and DOM-safe keyword linking without impacting database performance.

keyFeatures.title: Custom Cloaked Slug Architecture
keyFeatures.description: Convert long referral URLs into clean links using custom prefixes such as /go/, /recommends/, or /deal/.

keyFeatures.title: High-Speed HTTP Status Handling
keyFeatures.description: Full support for native 301 permanent, 302 temporary, and 307 dynamic redirections with cache-control headers.

keyFeatures.title: Automatic SEO Attribute Enforcement
keyFeatures.description: Automatically append rel="nofollow sponsored" and rel="noopener noreferrer" across all cloaked links.

keyFeatures.title: Dynamic FTC Auto-Disclosure Injector
keyFeatures.description: Automatically identifies cloaked URLs inside content and inserts compliant legal disclosures with flexible positioning.

keyFeatures.title: Dynamic Geolocation Routing
keyFeatures.description: Automatically routes traffic to country-specific merchant storefronts based on real-time visitor IP geolocation.

keyFeatures.title: A/B Split Testing & Traffic Rotation
keyFeatures.description: Distribute inbound clicks across multiple target URLs with percentage weights to identify top-converting vendor landing pages.

keyFeatures.title: Dynamic UTM Forwarding
keyFeatures.description: Intercepts inbound UTM query parameters and automatically attaches them to the destination link.

keyFeatures.title: Automated Deal Expiration & Fallbacks
keyFeatures.description: Establish calendar expiration dates or click thresholds that route visitors to evergreen fallback deals instead of dead 404 pages.

keyFeatures.title: DOM-Safe Keyword Auto-Linker
keyFeatures.description: Automatically transforms target keywords in existing posts into cloaked links without breaking headings, existing hyperlinks, or code blocks.

keyFeatures.title: Automated 404 Link Health Scanner
keyFeatures.description: Background health checks that alert you when affiliate destination links go offline or change.

documentationSections.title: Getting Started
documentationSections.content: Automatic WordPress Admin installation, manual ZIP upload, and FTP setup procedures.
steps: Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
Search for 'Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker' or upload the plugin ZIP file.
Activate the plugin and set your initial cloaking prefix in Settings.

documentationSections.title: Activating Pro
documentationSections.content: Entering and validating Freemius software license keys inside wp-admin.
steps: Go to Link Cloaker > Account in wp-admin.
Enter your Freemius license key.
Click Activate License to unlock Pro modules instantly.

documentationSections.title: Configuration Guide
documentationSections.content: Setting default 301 or 307 HTTP status codes and choosing global FTC disclosure placement.
steps: Configure default redirection status code (301 Permanent or 307 Temporary).
Choose FTC disclosure placement (Top of content, Bottom of content, or Before first commercial link).
Save changes to apply rules globally across all posts.

documentationSections.title: Advanced Modules
documentationSections.content: Configuring Cloudflare IP country headers for geolocation, setting up A/B split traffic percentages, and tuning keyword auto-linker thresholds.
steps: Enable Geo-Routing in link settings and map ISO country codes to targeted destination URLs.
Set percentage weights for A/B split testing URLs.
Define target keywords and maximum links per article in Auto-Linker settings.

documentationSections.title: Privacy & Security
documentationSections.content: Cookie-less execution details, PII-free data policies, and GDPR compliance validation.
steps: Zero telemetry and zero tracking of Personally Identifiable Information (PII).
All redirection data processed in-memory and stored locally in native WordPress Custom Post Types.
100% GDPR compliant out of the box.

name: ShelfMaster
tagline: Lightning-Fast, 100% Offline Desktop Application for Local and Small but Modern Libraries
description: An all-in-one local application replacing fragile spreadsheets and expensive cloud tools with unified cataloging, 3-second POS checkout, staff duty scheduling, payroll, and expense ledgers.

keyFeatures.title: Master Cataloging & Copy Tracking
keyFeatures.description: Catalog book editions, multi-author data, and ISBNs while managing physical shelf locations and accession barcodes.

keyFeatures.title: 3-Second POS Circulation Desk
keyFeatures.description: Scan member IDs and book barcodes to execute checkouts in seconds, complete with automated overdue fine calculation.

keyFeatures.title: Donors & Gift Registry
keyFeatures.description: Record donor profiles, track donated inventory with distinct tags, and print professional donation certificates.

keyFeatures.title: Dual Membership KYC System
keyFeatures.description: Register standard paying members or authorize waived special privilege memberships with built-in photo and ID card printing.

keyFeatures.title: Staff HR & Weekly Duty Roster
keyFeatures.description: Maintain complete staff directories and assign shift schedules and departmental duties through a visual calendar.

keyFeatures.title: Automated Payroll Engine
keyFeatures.description: Calculate net monthly salaries, manage deductions and overtime bonuses, and export official printable pay-slips.

keyFeatures.title: Institutional Expense Management
keyFeatures.description: Record day-to-day operating expenditures with voucher tracking, vendor notes, and category budgets.

keyFeatures.title: Unified Cash-Flow Ledger & Audits
keyFeatures.description: Automatically reconcile membership fees, late fines, staff payroll, and operational expenses into unified balance sheets.

keyFeatures.title: Hardware & Multi-Format Printing
keyFeatures.description: Full support for USB barcode scanners, 58mm/80mm thermal receipts, and full A4 administrative document printers.

features: Thermal receipt and A4 print drivers
Multi-seat deployment across regional library branches

documentationSections.title: System Setup
documentationSections.content: Installing native binaries on Windows (.msi/.exe), macOS (.dmg), or Linux (.deb/.AppImage) operating system.
steps: Download the official ShelfMaster installer package for your operating system.
Run the executable installer and follow setup prompts.
Launch ShelfMaster from your desktop or application launcher.

documentationSections.title: Database Initialization
documentationSections.content: Automatic local SQLite migration and Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) data safety.
steps: Upon first launch, ShelfMaster creates an encrypted local SQLite database.
Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) is enabled automatically for maximum performance and crash resilience.
No network connectivity or server setup is required.

documentationSections.title: Peripherals Integration
documentationSections.content: Configuring USB plug-and-play barcode scanners and setting up 58mm/80mm thermal receipt printers.
steps: Connect any USB HID barcode scanner (plug-and-play).
In Settings > Peripherals, choose your thermal printer paper width (58mm or 80mm).
Print a test receipt to confirm hardware driver alignment.

documentationSections.title: Financial Workflows
documentationSections.content: Generating monthly payroll, processing itemized expense vouchers, and running end-of-year audit reports.
steps: Navigate to Financial Ledger & Audits.
Log operational expense vouchers and staff salary payouts.
Export comprehensive PDF balance sheets for auditing.

documentationSections.title: Backup & Recovery
documentationSections.content: Generating encrypted local backup archives and executing one-click database restorations.
steps: Go to Settings > Backup & Security.
Click 'Export Database Backup' to create an encrypted .db snapshot.
To restore on another machine, use 'Import Backup Archive'.
